description: Establish a green baseline on a new feature branch off main. Confirm toolchain, install state, and that typecheck/lint/test/build all pass before any code changes.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen, confirm current branch is main at commit 89ac0a8 and working tree clean (git status). Do NOT touch the parked stash@{0}.
Create and checkout a new feature branch: git checkout -b feat/design-tweaks-trail-notebook-brand-icon.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build and capture that all pass (build is the authoritative Vercel check). Note any PRE-EXISTING lint warnings so later features add none.
acceptance_criteria: A new branch feat/design-tweaks-trail-notebook-brand-icon is checked out (NOT main).
npm run build completes successfully (tsc -b && vite build).
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run test all pass; any lint warnings are pre-existing and recorded.
verification: git branch --show-current prints the new feature branch name
findings: Baseline confirmed GREEN on new branch feat/design-tweaks-trail-notebook-brand-icon (off main @ 89ac0a8). node v22.23.3 / npm 11.4.2 via export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH".
